name: Dungar Longdrink
label: Quest
description: At Stormwind's Trade District roost, Dungar Longdrink arranges swift gryphon transport for supplies bound to Westfall's embattled defenders.

clips.title: The story
paras: At Stormwind's Trade District roost, Dungar Longdrink arranges swift gryphon transport for supplies bound to Westfall's embattled defenders.

Defias outlaws and feral harvest golems have pushed Westfall close to breaking point. Quartermaster Lewis and the People's Militia are desperate for provisions. Lewis sent word to the capital, and armorer Osric Strang packed the requested equipment. Carrying military cargo on foot through bandit-ridden Elwynn and Westfall takes precious time. Stormwind's new aerial routes offer a vital link to the frontier.

The gryphon roost sits in Stormwind's Trade District, where Dungar Longdrink coordinates courier and passenger flights. Wildhammer dwarves traditionally raise and handle these majestic beasts. They carry people and cargo across human lands when roosts at both ends know the route. Bringing Osric's heavy crate straight to Dungar teaches couriers how aerial logistics work. It connects the capital's stockpiles directly to frontier outposts such as Sentinel Hill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for. Can you take it to him?
If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him. Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.
Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can. We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is that sweat on your brow, lad? You've been running too much. Next time, take a gryphon!

clips.title: Completion
paras: A crate for Westfall, eh? Have you been to Westfall before? If so, then it's no problem, my friend. I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
